description.p: Chatot is a GTK4 native WhatsApp client for the desktop. It links to your phone as a companion device, like WhatsApp Web, and keeps your chats, groups, communities, channels and status updates.

ul.li: Text, replies, reactions, forwards, edits and deletes
Photos, videos, voice notes, documents, stickers and GIFs, with an in-app viewer
Locations with an inline map, live locations and place search
Groups, communities, channels and status updates
Full-text message search, archive, pins, mutes and starred messages
Several linked accounts in one window
Desktop notifications and a tray item with the unread count

description.p: Chatot is an unofficial client built on the whatsmeow library. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by WhatsApp or Meta. Using an unofficial client may be against WhatsApp's terms of service.

screenshot.caption: A chat with a link preview, a live location, an event and a voice note
Photos, clips, voice notes and documents in a chat
A group conversation with replies and mentions

description.p: Accents typed with dead keys now compose in the message input on GNOME and other desktops with an input method, as they already did in the search box.
Diagnostics for typing accents: with CHATOT_TRACE=1 the app logs how dead keys are composed in the message input and the search box, and it always logs which input method it uses.
The picture viewer pinch-zooms and drags to pan. Release builds: Flatpak bundles and AppImages for x86_64 and aarch64 are attached to every GitHub release.

A chat wallpaper: pick any picture under Preferences, and override it per chat from the chat menu with a picture of its own or the plain background. On a wide window the messages and the input stop growing and stay centred, as on WhatsApp Web. The sticker picker fills with the phone's recent stickers, a sticker in a chat can be added to it, and notifications show the contact's or group's picture.

First release on Flathub. Link previews under pasted links, sharp previews for pictures and clips that are not downloaded yet, and Copy image in the viewer. Voice notes remember their played state and position and advance to the next one. A reply quote jumps to the original message, and the chat list names who sent a group's last message. Sidebar refreshes and thread paging moved off the main loop, so long chats scroll smoothly.

Calls are logged in the thread and the chat list, and a call that rang while the machine was asleep no longer rings on resume. Reactions to your messages notify and show as the chat preview. Sends show at once with a pending clock and offer a retry on failure. GIF search, a sticker library and WhatsApp favourites.

The conversation thread is a GtkListView with relative scrolling, so older pages load without flicker. Preferences are fully wired: font size, window controls, notification sound and text privacy, message previews, tray icon, proxy, auto-download, storage and a log file. Packages can ship their own notification sound.
Smooth scrolling in long chats and the chat list, avatars from the disk cache first, the pairing screen returns after a logout, and unread badges leave the archive out like the phone does.
First public beta: chats, groups, communities, channels, status updates, media, voice notes, locations, search and multi-account support.
